problem: dispatch OP-X-013 CFB26 durable GitHub Action
approach: verify workflow_dispatch on working branch; expose only dedicated workflow on default branch; attempt available CLI/API execution routes
lesson: The dedicated manual workflow must exist on the default branch for normal workflow_dispatch visibility. Do not confuse repository permission with availability of a dispatch-capable tool.
